title: Fix PopupMenu horizontal margin in editor theme
rationale: theme_classic.cpp lines 1120-1121 still use p_config.separation_margin for item_start/end_padding and lack the PopupMenu h_separation constant; pre-image matches so the popup_margin/h_separation change applies cleanly (theme_modern already uses popup_margin).

title: Fix script editor guideline colors
rationale: editor_theme_manager.cpp:534 matches the old base_color/dark_color_2 form and p_config.contrast exists (editor_theme_manager.h:62); code_edit.cpp:452 still has the 0.5 alpha, so both edits apply.

title: Fix shrunken vertical borders for editor Labels
rationale: The LabelVMarginless type variation / v_marginless_style block the fix targets does not exist anywhere in editor/themes (grep found no LabelVMarginless in theme_classic.cpp or theme_modern.cpp), so the typo it corrects cannot manifest in the fork.

title: Fix icons colors for files and directories at light color preset
rationale: Already present: theme_classic.cpp:1037-1039 and theme_modern.cpp:1034-1036 already set FileDialog file/folder_thumbnail/file_thumbnail icons.

title: Prevent branding in Project Manager from being affected by icon saturation
rationale: TitleBarLogo is consumed only by editor/project_manager/project_manager.cpp:242 and the Project Manager is being removed from the fork (PR #1161), so exempting TitleBarLogo from icon saturation is dead branding.

title: Fix Audio bus effects section margin
rationale: EditorAudioBusEffectsTree h_separation=0 constant is absent in both themes; theme_classic.cpp lacks the type-variation block (insertion point at lines 2066-2070 matches) and theme_modern.cpp:2222 sets the stylebox but not the constant.

title: Fix PopupMenu sizing with search bar
rationale: Already fully present: popup_menu.cpp/.h search_bar_separation + body_max_w sizing, default_theme.cpp:772, PopupMenu.xml:763, and both editor themes already set search_bar_separation.

title: Fix cursor selection box color
rationale: theme_modern.cpp:218-219 still use the old mono_color*alpha box_selection fill/stroke colors that pre-image matches; change to the hardcoded gray Colors applies cleanly (fix only touches theme_modern).
